controller.scope: Transport joint preset, carrier layout proposal and timed cone manipulation reference. Native CAD contact fitting, feedback and final carton handoff are calibrated in MuJoCo.

robot: Clearpath Husky A200 with a Franka Emika Panda and parallel-jaw Panda Hand
assembly: The simulator assembles the two native models. The simulated integration plate and payload arrangement are specific to this task.
controller_detail: The preloaded carton rests freely on the CAD deck during crossing. At the receiving table, the native finger pads close on the carton. The temporary grasp is enabled only after opposed contact and released on measured table support.
carton_model: Genie Sim benchmark_carton_007, scaled to a small carton of school supplies.
